prose.name: Strike: The Raider's Ledger over <Planet>
prose.briefing: A raider working the lanes over <Planet> keeps a ledger of every hauler it has robbed. The haulers want the ledger, so the ship can't just be blown apart.
prose.card: A raider over <Planet> keeps a ledger of everyone they've robbed. We want it. Disable the ship, don't destroy it.

broadcast: They write down every ship they take, cargo and all, and that book is the only proof we've got. Aim for the engines, don't blow them apart, and mind the ones flying with them.

beats.objective: Disable and board the raider ship over <Planet>
beats.journal: I disabled the raider over <Planet>, boarded it and took the ledger.
say: That's every hauler they ever touched, written in their own hand. We'll be busy for a month.
